description: ENCRYPTED stays clear, but the CIPHER_ID sub-field (bits 2-3 of flags, mask 0x000C) is changed from 0 to 1 (ChaCha20-Poly1305) on a frame that is not encrypted. With ENCRYPTED clear there is no cipher in use, so CIPHER_ID must be 0; any non-zero value, even an assigned one, is rejected. The CRC is recomputed because flags is part of the header the CRC covers.
